visualCharacteristics: Light, minimal stacked list of expandable rows separated by thin grey divider lines. Each row has a purple "+" toggle at the left followed by the program title; opening a row reveals its details (text, links, PDF link lists) indented under the title and turns the + into a minus.
contentPattern: One row per item: cell 1 is the title (plain text, may include superscripts such as ®), cell 2 is the body (paragraphs, links, lists of PDF links). A single-cell row uses its first element as the title. A body holding only a link to a /fragments/ page is replaced by that fragment (e.g. a panel containing other blocks). The toggle icon is generated, never authored.
usage: Program and resource lists on benefits pages (e.g. Aetna extras, tools): each program title expands to show its description and downloads.
reuseGuidance: Use for any list of expandable title/detail rows. Built on details/summary so it is keyboard accessible; keep two cells per row.
